para_trans: On posting after re-instatement in government service
Government Order No: EST-5026 / Q. No.64 / Raushu-1
Madam Kama Marg, Martyr Rajguru Chowk,
1) Government Circular, General Administration Department, No.NIPRA-112 / Q. 82/11 -A, D. 20.04.2013.
2) GOVERNMENT ORDER, HOME DEPARTMENT, NO. EST- 5026 / P.No.64 / Raushu-1, D. 25.05.2026.

Shri Suraj Rattan Singh Daberao, Inspector, Group-B, State Excise, vide Reference No. 2 They have been reinstated in the government service subject to departmental / judicial inquiry under the orders of the government here.
Accordingly, Mr. Suraj Daberao, Inspector, State Excise is being reinstated in the non-executive position indicated before his name in the following table: -

2.The said orders shall come into force with immediate effect. The Inspector concerned should appear immediately at the place of posting allotted to him. The aforesaid officer after assuming charge of the said office submitted the report to the Government through the Commissioner, State Excise.

If any officer attempts to directly or indirectly pressurise for modification of the said order, disciplinary action shall be taken against the officer concerned on the ground that the act violates Rule 23 of the Maharashtra Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1979, treating it as misconduct.
